issues.text: Where the provider contract and registry of decisions/0127 (audit R-8) live and what they hold in M2. The task names them under REQ-118, but the server never runs providers (ARCH §0 item 2), so they are written in REQ-119. Recommended (a): the worker holds one contract and a frozen registry (app/worker/providers/), codes `api` (Messages API) and `scripted` (fixtures, demo) for the text kinds; one conformance suite runs over every registered code read at test time; `claude-cli` (builds through the core) and the core change of audit М-7 (getExecutor's if-chain in tools/src/team/executor.js → a map, core tests unchanged) join with R3.3 and R1.5 (CORE-1…CORE-9, not written yet), because only a build hosts the core and seven tools/test files call getExecutor; REQ-119 creates core-bridge.js as the only import site of tools/ and proves in the image that it loads the core modules. (b) put claude-cli and the core registry into REQ-119 now — a core change with its own guard tests in a block whose kinds never run the core; (c) keep it in REQ-118 as written in the task — impossible without breaking ARCH §0 item 2.

How the blocks treat `owner-local` (the subscription). Recommended (a): left out of V1 and named as left out: the worker modes are exactly `api` and `fake` (the check constraint of 0004 refuses `owner-local`), the admin cannot create such a token, the worker refuses the mode at start, and the claim filter has no owner-local branch; with it go runStructured (CORE-9), the owner-local guard of ARCH §8.9 and the AC2.8 rows about owner-local text jobs (decisions/0134 item 4: «`owner-local` is not on the client path»; G5 stays the owner's answer but has no code path). (b) keep the branch for the owner's own projects behind G5 — code, tests and a risk (PLAN G5 «Риск») for no step of the client path.

The isolation value before R7.1. Recommended (a): every worker token of V1 is `host`, even though the worker runs in a container, until R7.1 proves the egress and credential proxies; so the server never gives a build of another organisation to any worker before then (ARCH §8.3 `container` branch, §14.8: without the proxy the agent would hold the real key). This matters for the first client: his builds need R7.1 (decisions/0134 item 3 «the api worker for an organisation that is not the owner's (a part of M7: the container)»). (b) allow `container` now — a client build agent could read the API key from its environment.

Secrets in the container (decisions/0134 item 4 «environment or secret file»). Recommended (a): secret files only (Docker secrets under /run/secrets or a file the owner names), and a start with SAI_WORKER_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN set in the environment is refused: an environment value shows in `docker inspect`, in child processes and in compose files. (b) both forms — one more leak path.

How the owner gets the image. Recommended (a): he builds it himself from app/Dockerfile.worker at the released commit (`docker compose -f app/compose.yaml --profile worker build`; the base pinned by digest, npm ci from the lockfile); CI proves the same Dockerfile; no registry in V1. (b) publish to GHCR from a workflow — needs `packages: write` and a new workflow (a GitHub setting and a push of an artefact, the owner's gate, NEVER-DO 2).

CPU architectures. Recommended (a): CI proves linux/amd64 (the Windows PC and a common server); Docker Desktop on an Apple Silicon Mac can run it under emulation; a native arm64 build is added when the owner moves to a Mac (one CI job on the arm runner, a new requirement or a micro-amendment). (b) an arm64 build job now — more CI time for a host nobody uses yet.

Neon free compute and a worker that polls all the time. Every claim touches the database, so a 24/7 worker keeps Neon awake (the free compute quota is a vendor fact to verify at design, ARCH §8.6 **verify**). Recommended (a): keep the idle exit (SAI_WORKER_IDLE_EXIT_MIN, default 60) and `restart: "no"` in compose; a 24/7 worker for the client alone is the owner's host decision (G15) together with the Neon plan, raised when the first client is invited. (b) restart always — may exhaust the free compute; (c) no idle exit.

The result schemas of the text kinds before M3. Recommended (a): a closed registry of kinds in app/public/shared/ai/schemas.js (plain data, because public/shared may not import zod); REQ-118 registers `interview_turn` in a first version (a question with 2–4 options, or done) and the end-to-end tests use it; R3.1 refines it, R3.2 registers `spec_draft` and `spec_revise`, R3.3 and M4 `build`; a kind without a schema is never enqueued, claimed or completed; the claim filter's build branch is tested on rows inserted by SQL. (b) write all four schemas now — they belong to the ТЗ design of R3.2.

Left out of PLAN R2.5: events, files, artifact routes and the session part of a lost lease (their tables dev_sessions, office_events, artifacts, artifact_files come with M4; ARCH §4 does not put them in 0004). Recommended: leave out until R3.3/M4. (b) create those tables in 0004 now — tables and routes with no user and no test path.

The kill switch route. ARCH §13 puts POST /api/admin/kill-switch in M4; REQ-117 also leaves it out.
